entries.title: A crewmate on Claude carries on after the computer running it restarts in the middle of work it started in the background
entries.body: When a computer that runs work for you restarts while a crewmate there on Claude waits on work it started in the background, such as a test run, the crewmate is now told once that the work did not finish, and picks the task up again. Before, it could wait for a result that would never come.
entries.noPicture: Nothing new appears on screen: the task simply moves on after the restart instead of waiting.
